rulings.reason: The decremental PEEP trial at best respiratory-system elastance is one of the strategies the esophageal-guided condition is compared against; comparator_types should list it with the ARDSnet table.
The paper reports timing: procedures started 1 [range 0-4] day after initiation of mechanical ventilation (Table 1: MV prior the study, days 1 [0 - 4]); GLM's null discards a reported value.
24 patients were enrolled and completed the study procedures; 14 of them met Berlin ARDS criteria and are the analysed population. n_enrolled is 24, n_analysed 14.

PEEPDECREMENTAL is set by lowest respiratory-system elastance without any transpulmonary pressure target; ptp_target_subgroups lists transpulmonary target strategies only, so adding 'other' would wrongly place the study in a PTP subgroup.
